name: Coinsweeper Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Coinsweeper on Steam now!

 

Coinsweeper - Minesweeper meets Roguelike

Turn Minesweeper into a high-stakes treasure hunt! Reveal tiles to 
collect coins, upgrade your abilities between runs, and compete for the highest 
score. Will you play it safe or risk it all?

Features:
✓ Risk/reward gameplay - cash out anytime or push your luck
✓ Meta-progression with permanent upgrades
✓ Relaxing yet strategic gameplay
